title: Last-line contraction evaluated through the specified binary product
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting and Y separated finite type over k. Put m=d+1 for d>=0, and use C_j,T_j,U=C_1T_1 and t_Y from [def-pur-ordered-affine-trace-data]. Assume C_mT_m,U,C_(m+1)T_(m+1) are finite-Tor constructible [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] and UniversalLineBaseChange [def-pur-affine-space-binary-trace-coordinates]. Let kappa:C_(m+1)T_(m+1)≅C_mT_m tensor U, let h certify etale origin of H_m, and suppose kappa.inv equals the specified binaryForward(h). Then the canonical last-line projection is invertible, with proof hq, and the explicit L_m(h,hq) [def-pur-affine-space-last-line-contraction] equals kappa.hom followed by 1 tensor t_Y and the coefficient right unitor. This asserts no identity about exceptional transposes.

source.place: Integration on affine space, ordered trace recursion and projection formula

proof.text: The Tate powers are finite-Tor constructible by [prop-weil-twist-preserves]. The assumed compact-support images supply V,U and the next image. Compact-support base change and the finite compact projection formula make the specified exchange and projection maps invertible. The tensor-domain witnesses follow from ordinary finite-Tor representatives and their pulled-back tensor products.

Apply [lem-pur-base-changed-line-trace-evaluation] at f=p_m and M=T_m. UniversalLineBaseChange supplies its trace equation. Transport its evaluation map using the canonical Tate pullbacks, externalTateIso, successorSourceIso and the origin change to the standard projective-line compactification. Naturality of projection in the Tate coefficient, and cancellation of the lineCoordinate inverse pair in normalizedPulledTrace, identify the left side with L_m. The right side is D followed by 1 tensor t_Y and the right unitor.

Apply [lem-pur-affine-space-last-factor-product] on the same square. Its positiveTate presentation identifies with T_m by the coefficient left unitor. Transport through this isomorphism and the pullTate and appendTate identifications. Its finiteProductChosenForward is binaryForward: copied compactification contributes precisely rightDerivedLowerShriekCongr and the final object map is externalTateIso. The hypothesis on kappa.inv therefore makes D=kappa.hom by uniqueness of inverses. Substitute in the evaluation equality.

lean.statement:
theorem lastLineContraction_product
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aY] (d : ℕ)
    (hV : DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P)) Y
      ((compact P Y (d + 1)).obj (tate P Y (d + 1))))
    (hU : DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P)) Y
      ((compact P Y 1).obj (tate P Y 1)))
    (hNext : DerivedCategory.constructibleFiniteTor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P)) Y
      ((compact P Y (d + 2)).obj (tate P Y (d + 2))))
    (ht : UniversalLineBaseChange P Y aY)
    (kappa : (compact P Y (d + 2)).obj (tate P Y (d + 2)) ≅
      ((tensor (Ring P) Y).obj ((compact P Y (d + 1)).obj (tate P Y (d + 1)))).obj
        ((compact P Y 1).obj (tate P Y 1)))
    (h : DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P))
      (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 2)) (externalTate P Y (d + 1)))
    (hk : kappa.inv = binaryForward P Y aY d h) :
    ∃ hq : ProjectionInvertible (Ring P)
      (affineTraceLineCompactification (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 1)))
      (coefficient P.coefficients.l P.extension (P.level - 1)
        (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 1)) P.level (annihilates P)) (tate P Y (d + 1)),
    lastLineContraction P Y aY d h hq = kappa.hom ≫
      ((tensor (Ring P) Y).obj ((compact P Y (d + 1)).obj (tate P Y (d + 1)))).map
        (lineNormalizedIntegration P Y aY) ≫
      (moduleRightUnit (Ring P) Y
        ((compact P Y (d + 1)).obj (tate P Y (d + 1)))).hom
